# Routing and applicability

The executable router is lib/router.js. Resolve requested action separately from risks. Explicit action overrides are supported; they never grant authorization. Ordered clauses execute in order. Unknown requests produce clarify, not speculative changes. Risk detection is heuristic: inspect changed code and supply additional risks when needed.

For fallback routing, choose the workflow matching the requested action. Read-only explanations do not start implementation or incident workflows. For every relevant risk select matching controls below; projectTypes restrict applicability. Read only the referenced policy section when needed.
